name: Cole Hall
use: Thompson School: 150-seat lecture hall, commercial kitchen and student-run dining room for the culinary and hospitality programs, study lounge, offices
builtText: In use and named by 1990; construction start not confirmed (old data: 1987–90)

facts.text: Designed by Banwell Architects, Cole Hall was named in 1990 for Stacey Ward Cole (1921–2014), a 1941 Thompson School graduate, farmer, state representative and USNH trustee.
It contains a 150-seat lecture auditorium, a commercial kitchen and dining area, a student study and lounge area, a computer lab, a small classroom and administrative offices.
Thompson School restaurant-management students trained in two student-run restaurants in Cole Hall, Stacey's Buffet and the Balcony Bistro, during the academic year.

I couldn't open a source confirming the restaurant runs today. No renovation history. No licensed photo. No reviews found.
